data.professional_title: Senior Full Stack Developer (.NET + ReactJS) with 9+ Years of Experience
data.summary: Senior .NET Developer with 9.11 years of hands-on experience designing and developing scalable, high-performance web applications. Strong expertise in C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET MVC, RESTful APIs, and SQL Server, including query optimization and database performance tuning. Experienced in building responsive front-end solutions using ReactJS and integrating them with secure backend services. Proficient in clean architecture, dependency injection, unit testing, and Agile-based development practices.

raw_sections.summary:
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Senior .NET Developer with 9.11 years of hands-on experience designing and developing scalable, high-performance web applications. Strong expertise in C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET MVC, RESTful APIs, and SQL Server, including query optimization and database performance tuning. Experienced in building responsive front-end solutions using ReactJS and integrating them with secure backend services. Proficient in clean architecture, dependency injection, unit testing, and Agile-based development practices.
raw_sections.skills:
TECHNICAL SKILLS
Backend: C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET MVC, ASP.NET Web API, Razor Pages, ADO.NET, LINQ, Entity
Framework, Microservices
Frontend: ReactJS, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, jQuery • Database: Microsoft SQL Server • Cloud: Microsoft Azure • Reporting & BI: SSIS, SSRS, Power BI • DevOps & Tools: Git, GitHub, GitLab, TFS, Jenkins (CI/CD), Postman, Swagger, Docker • Code Quality & Security: SonarQube, Checkmarx, BlackDuck • Methodologies: Agile (Scrum), JIRA, Confluence
raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Globant India Pvt Ltd – Senior Software Developer (20th March 2026 – 14th July 2026)
Project: Academy Portal • Developed AI-powered Training Impact, Training Skill Extractor, and Glober Document
Update modules using .NET/C# and the Mistral-Nemo AI API.
Designed and optimized LLM prompts to improve reasoning quality, reduce hallucinations, and
produce structured JSON responses with matched skills, confidence scores, and detailed explanations.
Tech Mahindra Pvt Ltd – Senior Software Engineer (18th Sep 2024 – 20th Jan 2026)
Project: Aspireway Learning Continuum & Aspire4Education
Designed and developed scalable enterprise application modules using .NET Core, Razor
Pages, and SQL Server
Worked on an ASP.NET Core application with a microservice-based architecture, where
business capabilities such as Student, Grading, Strategic, and System were implemented as separate API services.
Modernized legacy user interfaces by developing and enhancing ReactJS-based UI
components, improving usability and responsiveness
Built reusable and maintainable React components using effective state management, props


handling, and client-side validations Integrated React front-end applications with RESTful APIs, ensuring efficient data exchange and optimized performance Improved UI performance by reducing unnecessary re-renders, optimizing API calls, and enhancing load times
Managed deployment of Aspire4Education REST APIs to Azure App Service, including

application publishing, environment configuration, and deployment validation. Designed and deployed SSRS reports to support business reporting and data-driven decision- making.
Worldpay – Senior Software Engineer (2nd Dec 2021 – 17th Sep 2024)
Project: Merchant Administrative System and Treasury Manager
Developed and maintained secure, high-volume payment processing modules using C#,
ASP.NET Core, and RESTful Web APIs
Designed resilient backend services and implemented a retry mechanism in Windows
Services, significantly improving transaction reliability
Applied Dependency Injection, Clean Architecture, and SOLID principles to enhance system
maintainability and scalability

BlackDuck
Collaborated with frontend and integration teams to define API contracts, data models, and
service interfaces
Provided production support by troubleshooting critical issues and delivering timely fixes for
high-priority payment flows
Tata Consultancy Services – System Engineer (6th Feb 2019 – 29th Nov 2021)
Project: Wealth Management Intranet Portal
Migrated legacy applications to ASP.NET MVC architecture • Developed UI components using JavaScript, Bootstrap, and jQuery • Created and optimized SQL stored procedures • Participated in requirement analysis and testing

Project: Poc to create json file from Excel file
Built APIs to convert Excel data into JSON for React applications • Worked closely with frontend teams for UI integration
ITShastra India Pvt Ltd – Junior Software Engineer (5th May 2016 – 2nd Nov 2018)
Project: CoreLogic & Vendor Management System
